description: This file defines a generic interface for a grain in the Orleans framework, specifying methods for setting, transforming, retrieving data, and comparing grain references.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the grain's data with the provided value of generic type T.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Performs a transformation operation on the grain.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the grain's data of type T.

methods.name: CompareGrainReferences
methods.description: Compares grain references to see if they point to the same grain.
